quote: You have loved and have been loved; know that in the moment of your transition, there will be love.
author: Rev. Randy Lewis
socialPost:
In times of reflection, remember that love surrounds us, transcending even our most challenging moments. Embrace the warmth that remains, reminding us we are never alone.

#LoveBeyond #TransitionWithGrace #EmbraceCompassion #HeartfeltConnections
